"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import {
  ArchiveIcon,
  ArrowLeftIcon,
  CalendarPlusIcon,
  ClockIcon,
  ListFilterIcon,
  MailCheckIcon,
  MoreHorizontalIcon,
  TagIcon,
  Trash2Icon,
} from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "../ui/button";
import { ButtonGroup } from "../ui/button-group";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,

} from "../ui/dropdown-menu";

export default function ButtonGroupDemo() {
  const [label, setLabel] = React.useState("personal");

  return (
    <ButtonGroup>
      <ButtonGroup className="hidden sm:flex">
        <Button variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="Go Back">
          <ArrowLeftIcon />
        </Button>
      </ButtonGroup>
      <ButtonGroup>
        <Button variant="outline">Archive</Button>
        <Button variant="outline">Report</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>
      <ButtonGroup>
        <Button variant="outline">Snooze</Button>
        <DropdownMenu>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="More Options">
              <MoreHorizontalIcon />
            </Button>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-52">
            <DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuItem>
                <MailCheckIcon />
                Mark as Read
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>
                <ArchiveIcon />
                Archive
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuItem>
                <ClockIcon />
                Snooze
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>
                <CalendarPlusIcon />
                Add to Calendar
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>
                <ListFilterIcon />
                Add to List
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuSub>
                <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                  <TagIcon />
                  Label As...
                </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
                <DropdownMenuSubContent>
                  <DropdownMenuRadioGroup
                    value={label}
                    onValueChange={setLabel}
                  >
                    <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="personal">
                      Personal
                    </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
                    <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="work">
                      Work
                    </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
                    <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="other">
                      Other
                    </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
                  </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
                </DropdownMenuSubContent>
              </DropdownMenuSub>
            </DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuGroup>
              <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">
                <Trash2Icon />
                Trash
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuGroup>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </ButtonGroup>
    </ButtonGroup>
  );
}

export default function ContextMenuDemo() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu>
      <ContextMenuTrigger className="flex h-[150px] w-[300px] items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed text-sm">
        Right click here

            <ContextMenuItem>Create Shortcut...</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuItem>Name Window...</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuSeparator />
            <ContextMenuItem>Developer Tools</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuSeparator />

        </ContextMenuSub>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />

          Show Bookmarks

        <ContextMenuCheckboxItem>Show Full URLs</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>

            Pedro Duarte

          <ContextMenuRadioItem value="colm">Colm Tuite</ContextMenuRadioItem>

      </ContextMenuContent>

}

          <MenubarItem>Paste</MenubarItem>

        <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>

          <MenubarCheckboxItem>Always Show Bookmarks Bar</MenubarCheckboxItem>

# Migbits — the complete shadcn collection

65 shadcn/ui component modules, 65 runnable preview examples, and three compositions (date picker, TanStack data table, typography). Upstream source and examples are MIT licensed; retain components/ui/LICENSE and ORIGIN.json. Runtime dependency notices are in licenses/. The original Migbits profile-settings resource and the rest of the website are not relicensed by this pack.

## Setup

Merge the exact dependencies in package.json into your React application's package.json and install them. React 19.3.0 and React DOM 19.3.0 were used for validation. Preserve components/, hooks/, lib/, and styles/. Import styles/globals.css once in a Tailwind CSS v4 project. No Next.js runtime is needed. This is source code, not precompiled CSS.

Import a module: import { Button } from './components/ui/button'.
Import a working example: import Example from './components/examples/dialog'.
Import a composition: import DataTable from './components/patterns/data-table'.

## Preview theme

Wrap examples with className="oss-kit" and data-appearance="dark" or "light". For portalled surfaces to share the theme, set document.body.dataset.componentTheme to the selected appearance while your preview is mounted, and remove it on cleanup. Add className="dark" to the preview wrapper for dark utilities. The theme's variables are in styles/ui-theme.css. Typography and surface values remain yours to customize.

Some demo links open the original shadcn documentation. Demonstration forms, chat elements, attachments, and notifications are local examples, not account, payment, upload, messaging, or AI backends. Replace sample handlers with your own authenticated integration when appropriate.
